capabilities: Sync reMarkable documents into the vault on request
Extract highlights and typed text into a per-document Markdown file organized by page
Provide access to synced notebooks as PDF or Markdown files
Carry reMarkable tags into frontmatter and page headings
Browse the reMarkable file tree from an Obsidian pane
extras: Sync requires a paid subscription (€22 yearly for students and academics, €40 for professionals); the plugin is open source with code and a community Discord linked externally.
motivation: The README says the reMarkable is a great device but it can be frustrating or worrisome that all notes and documents are stored in only one place; the plugin stores them safely in the vault.
problem: reMarkable tablet notes and highlights live only on the device, so users cannot search or reference them inside Obsidian.

relations.evidence: access your handwritten notes from a reMarkable tablet

summary: Sync service and plugin that pulls highlights, typed text, and documents from a reMarkable tablet into Markdown and PDF files in the vault.
